cacheHitRateTooltip: Cached input tokens divided by total input tokens in the latest displayed usage snapshot. This is the cached share of input tokens, not a count of request-level cache-hit events; -- is shown when no input tokens are available.
contextUnavailable: This task did not report a context-window size, so usage cannot be calculated.
estimatedCostTooltip: An API text-price estimate, not a subscription bill or actual charge. Claude prices deduplicated responses; newly observed usage retains model, prompt tier and time pricing. Pre-observation Codex totals use standard short-context rates. DeepSeek history without request times, missing holiday calendars and unknown prices show --. Unreported processing, regional and tool fees are excluded.
behaviorHint: Keep task interaction, quiet-time reduction, and context safeguards together without crowding the HUD.
taskNavigationHint: Uses Codex's supported task deep link for Codex Desktop tasks; no window automation or session-file writes.
openTaskOnDoubleClick: Double-click a Codex Desktop task row or bubble to open it in Codex
openTaskTooltip: Double-click to open this task in Codex
idleIndicatorHint: After a long quiet period, retract to one overall light or a numbered row/column of task lights. Hover or new activity expands it immediately.
idleIndicatorEnabled: Retract to the status light when quiet
contextAlertsHint: Defaults are 75%, 90%, and 98%. Enter one to three whole percentages from 1–99 in any order; duplicates are removed and saved from low to high.
contextMetricVisible: Show context usage in detached bubbles (always shown in the list; required for alerts)
contextDependencyEnabled: Context usage is now visible and alerts are enabled.
contextDependencyDisabled: Context alerts were turned off because context usage is hidden.
contextThresholdsInvalid: Enter one to three whole percentages from 1 to 99.
multiTaskExplanation: Choose the default view. The summary arrow can expand the task list at any time; detached bubbles show tasks separately.
listDensityCompactHint: Tighter padding and gaps in the main bubble, task rows and detached bubbles. Layout, type and fields stay the same.
listDensityBalancedHint: Moderate padding and gaps across the main bubble, task rows and detached bubbles. Layout, type and fields stay the same.
listDensityRelaxedHint: More padding, gaps and click area across bubbles and task rows. Layout, type and fields stay the same.
taskListScopeHint: Applies to the expanded list, not the summary strip or detached bubbles.
listDensityHint: Changes row height, padding and button spacing. Choose content with List details below.
listRowsHint: Task identity and metrics side by side, for scanning several tasks.
listCardsHint: One card per task, with identity above its metrics.
listRailHint: A status-color rail beside each task and its metrics.
taskNameHint: Applies to lists and detached bubbles. Hover for full identity.
autoSplitNewTasks: Auto-split new tasks while in split mode
listDetailHint: Compact: status, model, context and cache hit. Balanced adds the call total. Detailed adds a second line with input mix, output, task total, window, cost and time.
taskBubbleResizeHint: Detached bubbles have their own content and size. Drag a corner to resize; list spacing and the main bubble layout do not apply.
dismissTask: Remove from HUD; it returns when this conversation runs again
closeTaskBubble: Close only this detached bubble; monitoring continues in the main HUD
sessionSourcesHint: Task rows use compact source icons only; hover an icon for its full name. The controls below let you monitor each Codex, Claude Code and DeepSeek Harness source independently.
sourceDefaultCliOption: Codex CLI — default profile (usually OpenAI / GPT)
sessionSourcesPrivacy: Read-only: the HUD reads only Codex sessions and session_index.jsonl, metadata and token usage from Claude Code project sessions, Claude Desktop's usage percentages, and DeepSeek Harness's session projection cache (title, model, tokens and turn state). It never reads or changes provider configuration, authentication, prompts, replies or archives. Claude hooks report lifecycle events only.
sourceBreakdownTooltip: Visible task counts grouped by agent
agentNotificationHint: Allow Codex or Claude Code to show a short plain-text notice when it genuinely needs you to return. Off by default; the notice appears as a labelled card next to the HUD with its own color and motion, separate from automatic completion/error reminders. Maximum 160 characters; no links, rich text, or scripts.
agentNotificationEnabled: Allow proactive agent notices (off by default)
agentNotificationTooltip: When enabled, Codex or Claude Code can call monitor_hud_notify with short plain text. Safe live choreography also lets the agent combine bounded glow, pulse, breathe, flow, color, tempo and cycles without executing code. The notice card names its source and task number; list/split mode also animates only the matching task.
quotaGuardHint: Uses Codex account allowance at checkpoints to request a recoverable handoff. It does not interrupt generation or apply this guard to Claude or DeepSeek.
quotaGuardEnabled: Enable: let Codex leave a handoff when allowance is low
quotaGuardThresholdHint: Enter remaining percentages. Handoff thresholds cannot exceed preparation thresholds.
quotaGuardThresholdInvalid: Enter whole percentages from 1 to 99 for allowance thresholds.
quotaGuardPrepareSub: Leave a safe continuation point before the next large step
quotaGuardHandoffSub: Do not start broad new work; preserve a recoverable state first
quotaGuardTemplatesHint: The defaults update an existing project handoff first. Adapt them to your own workflow when needed.
quotaGuardPrepareDefault: Allowance is in the early-warning range. Before starting an expensive or broad next step, check whether this project already has a handoff document or required wrap-up format and update it if so. Otherwise create a concise, recoverable handoff in an appropriate project location: current goal and progress, changed files, verification, unfinished work, and the exact next command. Then decide whether to continue.
quotaGuardHandoffDefault: Allowance is critically low. Do not start broad or expensive new work; first update this project's existing handoff document or required format. If none exists, write a recoverable handoff with the current goal and progress, changed files, verification, unfinished work, risks or blockers, and the exact next command. Save it, then stop expanding scope so the next session can continue here.
quotaGuardTooltip: Enter whole percentages from 1 to 99. Defaults are 15 / 10 for early warning and 5 / 3 for critical handoff. A critical value is automatically kept at or below its matching early-warning value. A connected Codex reads this through monitor_hud_quota_guard at natural checkpoints; the HUD cannot inject or interrupt a turn by itself.
attentionHint: Put motion only on the task that actually needs you back.
attentionTooltip: Codex task_complete and Claude Stop mark the end of one turn, not permanent completion of the whole conversation. The HUD ignores silent endings with no visible final message and waits 8 seconds to confirm that another turn did not immediately start. It does not read or analyze your message text.
attentionRoutingTooltip: Summary mode reacts only on the summary bubble. List mode reacts only on the matching task row. Split or detached mode reacts only on the matching independent bubble; other tasks stay still.
dotAttentionHint: Flash pattern, brightness and subtle scale breathing are independent. This reminder stays hidden when the status dot is disabled in Appearance.
attentionCompletedTooltip: Remind after one Codex or Claude turn has finished producing visible output and has not immediately resumed within 8 seconds. This can mean that your review or input is needed; it does not mean the entire conversation goal is complete.
attentionWaitingTooltip: Remind when Claude Code asks for a permission decision or has been waiting for your input (reported by the Claude Notification hook).
attentionAbortedOrErrorTooltip: Remind when the agent explicitly aborts or the HUD temporarily cannot read new session data.
attentionSettledTooltip: Infers quiet from a period with no new tokens and can mistake a thinking gap for an ending. Disabled by default to reduce false positives.
settingsSubtitle: Lightweight real-time monitoring for Codex, Claude Code and DeepSeek Harness
presetsHint: Choose a polished starting point, then tune it to your workflow.
themeWorkshopHint: Import validates, installs and immediately applies a theme. Updates keep installed theme files.
themeWorkshopTooltip: Supports declarative .json / .cmhud-theme files and .cmhud-theme.zip packs with local PNG/JPG background assets. Scripts and network resources are never loaded.
layoutChipsHint: Horizontal groups in filled chips. Applies to the main bubble header only.
layoutCompactHint: Smaller chips and less padding, with the same type size and content.
layoutInlineHint: Plain text with separators. Wraps when the screen is too narrow.
layoutOutlineHint: Horizontal groups separated by subtle outlines.
layoutCardsHint: Labels above values, including rhythm, task counts and allowance groups.
layoutStackedHint: Information groups stacked vertically, suited to a screen edge.
activeWindowHint: Hide ordinary tasks after this period without activity. Tasks awaiting input or still running remain visible.
terminalExitHint: After retention ends, only the corresponding list row or detached bubble plays this bounded departure animation.
metricsHint: Only totals that remain meaningful across tasks, active count, and account allowances belong here. Model, context, cache hit rate, task total, and updated time are per-task data shown in the list or detached bubbles. Cached input is part of input.
pricingSourceHint: Bundled prices checked 2026-10-27 cover the displayed OpenAI, Claude and DeepSeek models, including long-context and DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates. API text-price estimates only; missing historical times are not guessed. Blank uses the bundled snapshot; a local pricing file is also supported.
pricingPathTooltip: Compatible with codex-usage-tracker-pricing-v1: model entries use USD per million input, cached-input and output tokens, with optional aliases. Only local JSON is read; no network request is made.
transparencyHint: Higher means more opaque. Layered fades the background first, then text and status: everything fades to 0%, with an opaque background at 100%. Focus further fades idle states.
mousePassthroughHint: When enabled, the HUD no longer receives mouse input. Use the desktop/Start settings shortcut, the tray icon, or ask Codex / Claude to disable click-through.
mousePassthroughConfirm: You will not be able to drag, double-click or right-click the HUD while click-through is enabled. The settings window will stay open as an immediate recovery path; later, use the tray icon, the settings shortcut or ask Codex / Claude to disable it.
statusDotHint: Controls the summary dot only. Lists and detached bubbles keep their own dots.
cornerRadiusHint: Shapes the outer shells. Inner chips and list cards keep their own proportions.
backgroundFallbackHint: This theme uses a gradient or image. This is its fallback color.
animateUpdatesTooltip: Smoothly collapses and expands quiet mode, with gentle task and status transitions. Token counter refreshes do not flash the window.
statusPalettesHint: A scheme changes the seven status colors; every color remains individually editable. Completion uses green, while abort and error demand attention.
statusPaletteCodexMicroSource: Codex Micro reference values were sampled from OpenAI's public Codex Micro page. They are local visual references only; OpenAI does not endorse this project, and device, display, color-management, accessibility, and theme differences can prevent a match with the page or hardware lighting.
rhythmTooltip: Token rhythm over the last {0} minutes and today's total (as observed by the HUD)
resizeMainBubble: Drag to add spacing · double-click for layout defaults
pageGeneralHint: Language, position, monitoring scope and pricing.
pageMainBubbleHint: What the always-on bubble shows and how. Drag its corner to loosen spacing.
pageTasksHint: Task list, separate task bubbles and how long tasks stay.
pageAlertsHint: Context alerts, the quota guard and agent notices.
pageAgentsHint: Which agents to monitor, plan usage and balance.
positionHint: You can also drag the HUD; its position is remembered.
monitorScopeHint: Use the latest task or sum visible tasks for token totals. The list, task count and account allowance stay independent.
resetDefaultsHint: Resets configuration and theme selection. Installed themes, pricing files and saved API keys are kept.
contextThresholdsHint: Alert once when context use passes these percentages.
mainLeadHint: What comes first: usage metrics, recent activity rhythm, or nothing.
mainStatusHint: Compact shows counts only; Classic lists each state.
mainQuotaStyleHint: Only agents with live tasks appear. Compact readings show 5h / weekly percentages, or only the DeepSeek Harness balance.
mainHideEmptyHint: Quotas or balances not read yet take no space.
mainWaitingBadgeHint: Lights up first when a task is waiting for your reply or approval.
mainSizeHint: Drag the corner to add space to the selected layout without changing type size. Double-click for that layout's default spacing.
mainMetricsInactive: Shown when Lead is set to Metrics.
mainRhythmInactive: Applies when Lead is set to Rhythm.
rhythmHint: Tokens per minute over the recent window, plus today's total.
rhythmCostHint: Estimated from public API prices, not your bill.
previewMessage: Agent notices appear here. Colors and effects follow your settings.
previewNoticeOff: Agent notices are off. Enable them to preview the card and effects.
codexQuotaSourceHint: Newest observations first; background reads every 30s while active and when Settings opens.
claudeQuotaSourceHint: Local record changes sync in about 1–2s; Claude Desktop controls the sampling interval.
claudeQuotaNone: No Claude Desktop usage samples yet
dshBalanceSourceHint: Needs a DeepSeek API key on the Agents page.
dshApiKeyHint: Used only to read your balance.
dshApiKeyInvalid: That doesn't look like a DeepSeek API key (it should start with sk-)
dshApiKeySaveFailed: Couldn't save the key. Try again.
dshApiKeyPrivacy: The key is encrypted with Windows DPAPI for the current user and kept out of the settings file. It is sent only to api.deepseek.com to read the balance, and never appears in logs, previews or the clipboard.
dshBalanceRefreshHint: Checks every 30s while active, after a turn settles, and when Settings opens.
dshBalanceNetwork: Can't reach DeepSeek right now; will retry
averageTpsHint: Updates every 30 seconds; the first valid sample appears immediately. Tools, waiting and idle show 0. Missing matched token/timing data shows --. Hover task information for the source basis.
averageTpsCodex: Codex: up to 5 valid responses in the last 5 minutes; output tokens / model output time, including reasoning and excluding tool execution.
averageTpsClaude: Claude Code: up to 5 requests in the last 5 minutes; output tokens / API request time, including first-token wait and excluding tools between requests.
averageTpsDsh: DeepSeek Harness: native session decodeTokens / decodeMs, excluding first-token wait and tool execution.
averageTpsUnavailable: No matched output-token and model-timing samples yet. Whole-task time is never substituted.
